% Pattern: case/layout. A case head after a bullet written by hand and thin
% spaces, and a case head underlined inside an italic group. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want head-1 other/case 1 parent=proof-1
% want head-2 other/case 2 parent=proof-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma} Every compact space is bounded. \end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
We argue by cases.

$\bullet$\,\,\,{\it Case 1:} The space is finite. Then it is bounded.

{\it \underline{Case 2:} The space is infinite.} Then a finite subcover bounds it.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
